stem.text: Magnesium hydroxide dissolves in aqueous ammonium chloride, but not in aqueous sodium chloride.

A.text: The ionic radius of the $\text{NH}_4^{+}$ ion is similar to that of $\text{Mg}^{2+}$ but not that of $\text{Na}^{+}$.

C.text: The $\text{Na}^{+}$ and $\text{Mg}^{2+}$ ions have the same number of electrons.

D.text: The $\text{NH}_4^{+}$ ion can donate a proton.
